== frame in_subdir cursor=1,27
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd subdir
|testuser@<HOST> ~/subdir $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/subdir
== frame after_cd_minus cursor=3,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd subdir
|testuser@<HOST> ~/subdir $ cd -
|<HOME>
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/subdir
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame after_pwd cursor=6,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd subdir
|testuser@<HOST> ~/subdir $ cd -
|<HOME>
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ pwd
|<HOME>
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~/subdir
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cd
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 pwd
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
